rows.en: Force the Will Wipps to retreat
rows.speaker: HUD

rows.en: In the <pic(0)><cs(3)>mountains near the UCE spaceport<ce()>, <mk(-17,-42.5,3,1)><ar(0,3,1,150)><mk(8,-67,3,1,1,50)><ar(0,3,1,150)><mk(50,25,7,3,250)><ar(0,7,3,350)><mk(75,0,7,3,250)><ar(0,7,3,350)>the Drake Army is reportedly fighting the UCE.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: Together with the <pic(1)><cs(3)>Gran Garan<ce()>, we will now <mk(-62.5,-12.5,2,0)><ar(0,2,0,100)><mk(-62.5,25,2,3,50)><ar(0,2,3,100)>head there and support our allies.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: ...Everything we have been doing since we returned to Earth was just setting the stage.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: We were made to play along with their experiments on new E2-powered machines.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: Once this operation is over, you will be explaining yourself... Duke Dermail.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: Today, our UCE succeeded in launching the <cs(1)>new units<ce()> it has been secretly developing.
rows.speaker: Duke Dermail?

rows.en: As of today, the UCE Space Force on standby near Earth begins a full invasion of space.
rows.speaker: Duke Dermail?

rows.en: Our first target is the civilian colony Sweetwater.
rows.speaker: Duke Dermail?

rows.en: This colony recently declared independence from Earth and a monopoly on its resources.
rows.speaker: Duke Dermail?

rows.en: Such tyranny will not be tolerated. Those who disturb order must face judgment.
rows.speaker: Duke Dermail?

rows.en: If this invasion succeeds, order across the Earth Sphere will not be far off.
rows.speaker: Duke Dermail?

rows.en: All forces, I expect the best possible results from you. That is all.
rows.speaker: Duke Dermail?

rows.en: What on earth are you doing in a place like this? Think about what your role is.
